packageRules.description: One weekly MR for all minor and patch updates
Major updates stay separate and are reviewed one by one
CI service images stay on the runner-cached digests (new digests time out on pull); bump only with a runner cache refresh
OpenSpec 1.14.1 promotes existing long-requirement INFO diagnostics to WARNING, failing spec:check for 116 specs; 1.14.0 passes all 181 items (TASK-359)

Radix UI 1.7.0 appends its generated description ID to custom aria-describedby; our DialogDescription asChild supplies a custom ID, leaving the appended reference unresolved (4 DOM regressions, TASK-359)
Node 26.11.0 was released on 2026-10-07 but its official bookworm/alpine tags return MANIFEST_UNKNOWN; preserve synchronized 26.10.0 until images are published (TASK-359)
PostgreSQL 18.6 rejects the existing PostgreSQL 15 data directory; a data migration is required before changing the deployed storage major (guarded container proof, TASK-359)
The deployed pgvector image must retain its PostgreSQL 15 storage major; PostgreSQL 18.6 rejects existing data files (TASK-359)
axe-core 4.14.0 enables label-content-name-mismatch and reports one serious violation on the real Lead page; 4.13.0 reports zero on the same DOM (TASK-359)
